ej/instance/741/desc.en: The Molten Core lies at the very bottom of Blackrock Depths. It is the heart of Blackrock Mountain and the exact spot where, long ago in a desperate bid to turn the tide of the dwarven civil war, Emperor Thaurissan summoned the elemental Firelord, Ragnaros, into the world. Though the fire lord is incapable of straying far from the blazing Core, it is believed that his elemental minions command the Dark Iron dwarves, who are in the midst of creating armies out of living stone. The burning lake where Ragnaros lies sleeping acts as a rift connecting to the plane of fire, allowing the malicious elementals to pass through. Chief among Ragnaros' agents is Majordomo Executus - for this cunning elemental is the only one capable of calling the Firelord from his slumber.

ej/instance/760/desc.en: Onyxia is the daughter of the mighty dragon Deathwing, and sister of the scheming Nefarian Lord of Blackrock Spire. It is said that Onyxia delights in corrupting the mortal races by meddling in their political affairs. To this end it is believed that she takes on various humanoid forms and uses her charm and power to influence delicate matters between the different races. Some believe that Onyxia has even assumed an alias once used by her father - the title of the royal House Prestor. When not meddling in mortal concerns, Onyxia resides in a fiery cave below the Dragonmurk, a dismal swamp located within Dustwallow Marsh. There she is guarded by her kin, the remaining members of the insidious Black Dragon Flight.

ej/instance/743/desc.en: During the final hours of the War of the Shifting Sands, the combined forces of the night elves and the four dragonflights drove the battle to the very heart of the qiraji empire, to the fortress city of Ahn'Qiraj. Yet at the city gates, the armies of Kalimdor encountered a concentration of silithid war drones more massive than any they had encountered before. Ultimately the silithid and their qiraji masters were not defeated, but merely imprisoned inside a magical barrier, and the war left the cursed city in ruins. A thousand years have passed since that day, but the qiraji forces have not been idle. A new and terrible army has been spawned from the hives, and the ruins of Ahn'Qiraj are teeming once again with swarming masses of silithid and qiraji. This threat must be eliminated, or else all of Azeroth may fall before the terrifying might of the new qiraji army.
ej/instance/743/desc.note: the Adventure Guide's description of Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj

ej/section/15370001/text.en: Buru fixates on a single player and pursues them at full speed, ignoring all others. The raid must kite him among his eggs.
ej/section/15370001/text.note: what an ability or phase of Buru the Gorger, a boss in Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj does (title: Full Speed)

ej/section/15370002/title.note: the name of an ability or phase of Buru the Gorger, a boss in Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj

ej/section/15370002/text.en: Buru takes greatly reduced damage until his eggs are destroyed. Each egg explodes violently when broken, weakening Buru but harming the raid.
ej/section/15370002/text.note: what an ability or phase of Buru the Gorger, a boss in Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj does (title: Egg Explosion)

ej/section/15370003/text.en: Once his eggs are gone, Buru afflicts the raid with a creeping plague, inflicting escalating Nature damage over time.
ej/section/15370003/text.note: what an ability or phase of Buru the Gorger, a boss in Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj does (title: Creeping Plague)

ej/section/15369001/text.en: Ayamiss paralyzes a random player and levitates them to the sacrificial altar, where her swarmers feed on them unless the raid intervenes.
ej/section/15369001/text.note: what an ability or phase of Ayamiss the Hunter, a boss in Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj does (title: Paralyze)

ej/section/15369002/text.en: Ayamiss sprays a volley of stingers, inflicting Nature damage to players in front of her.
ej/section/15369002/text.note: what an ability or phase of Ayamiss the Hunter, a boss in Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj does (title: Stinger Spray)

ej/section/15369003/text.en: While airborne, Ayamiss looses a poison stinger at a distant player, inflicting heavy Nature damage.
ej/section/15369003/text.note: what an ability or phase of Ayamiss the Hunter, a boss in Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj does (title: Poison Stinger)

ej/section/15339001/text.en: Ossirian gains a stacking buff that steadily increases his damage. It can only be stripped by luring him onto one of the Crystals scattered around the arena.
ej/section/15339001/text.note: what an ability or phase of Ossirian the Unscarred, a boss in Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj does (title: Strength of Ossirian)

ej/section/15339002/text.en: Tornadoes of sand sweep across the arena, hurling any player they touch high into the air.
ej/section/15339002/text.note: what an ability or phase of Ossirian the Unscarred, a boss in Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj does (title: Sand Storm)

ej/section/15339003/title.note: the name of an ability or phase of Ossirian the Unscarred, a boss in Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj

ej/section/15339003/text.en: If Ossirian is not weakened at a crystal in time, he enters Supreme Mode and devastates the raid with overwhelming force.
ej/section/15339003/text.note: what an ability or phase of Ossirian the Unscarred, a boss in Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj does (title: Supreme Mode)

ej/instance/744/desc.en: At the heart of Ahn'Qiraj lies an ancient temple complex. Built in the time before recorded history, it is both a monument to unspeakable gods and a massive breeding ground for the qiraji army. Since the War of the Shifting Sands ended a thousand years ago, the Twin Emperors of the qiraji empire have been trapped inside their temple, barely contained behind the magical barrier erected by the bronze dragon Anachronos and the night elves. Now that the Scepter of the Shifting Sands has been reassembled and the seal has been broken, the way into the inner sanctum of Ahn'Qiraj is open. Beyond the crawling madness of the hives, beneath the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj, legions of qiraji prepare for invasion. They must be stopped at all costs before they can unleash their voracious insectoid armies on Kalimdor once again, and a second War of the Shifting Sands breaks loose!
ej/instance/744/desc.note: the Adventure Guide's description of Temple of Ahn'Qiraj

ej/section/15263001/text.en: Skeram seizes control of a player's mind, turning them against the raid for a time.
ej/section/15263001/text.note: what an ability or phase of The Prophet Skeram, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj does (title: True Fulfillment)

ej/section/15263002/text.en: Skeram releases a burst of arcane energy, inflicting heavy Arcane damage to all nearby players.
ej/section/15263002/text.note: what an ability or phase of The Prophet Skeram, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj does (title: Arcane Explosion)

ej/section/15263003/text.en: Skeram blasts a player with Earth Shock, inflicting Nature damage and interrupting their spellcasting.
ej/section/15263003/text.note: what an ability or phase of The Prophet Skeram, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj does (title: Earth Shock)

ej/section/15263004/title.note: the name of an ability or phase of The Prophet Skeram, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj

ej/section/15263004/text.en: At intervals Skeram splits into illusory copies of himself, each able to cast his spells. The images must be cut down to find the true Prophet.
ej/section/15263004/text.note: what an ability or phase of The Prophet Skeram, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj does (title: Mirror Image)

ej/section/15511001/title.note: the name of an ability or phase of Silithid Royalty, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj

ej/section/15511001/text.en: Lord Kri looses a volley of toxic spines, inflicting Nature damage and poisoning the raid.
ej/section/15511001/text.note: what an ability or phase of Silithid Royalty, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj does (title: Lord Kri: Toxic Volley)

ej/section/15511002/title.note: the name of an ability or phase of Silithid Royalty, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj

ej/section/15511002/text.en: When Lord Kri dies, his corpse bursts into a lingering cloud of poison that inflicts heavy Nature damage to any who linger in it.
ej/section/15511002/text.note: what an ability or phase of Silithid Royalty, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj does (title: Lord Kri: Poison Cloud)

ej/section/15511003/title.note: the name of an ability or phase of Silithid Royalty, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj

ej/section/15511003/text.en: Vem charges across the room and knocks his target away, constantly closing and resetting distance.
ej/section/15511003/text.note: what an ability or phase of Silithid Royalty, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj does (title: Vem: Charge & Knock Away)

ej/section/15511004/title.note: the name of an ability or phase of Silithid Royalty, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj

ej/section/15511004/text.en: Should Vem fall before his siblings, Princess Yauj and Lord Kri fly into an enrage for the rest of the fight — Vem must be slain last.
ej/section/15511004/text.note: what an ability or phase of Silithid Royalty, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj does (title: Vem's Fury)

ej/section/15511005/title.note: the name of an ability or phase of Silithid Royalty, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj

ej/section/15511005/text.en: Princess Yauj channels powerful heals on her brothers, undoing the raid's progress unless interrupted.
ej/section/15511005/text.note: what an ability or phase of Silithid Royalty, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj does (title: Princess Yauj: Heal)

ej/section/15511006/title.note: the name of an ability or phase of Silithid Royalty, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj

ej/section/15511006/text.en: Princess Yauj terrifies nearby players, causing them to flee, and summons Yauj Brood on her death.
ej/section/15511006/text.note: what an ability or phase of Silithid Royalty, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj does (title: Princess Yauj: Fear)

ej/section/15516001/text.en: Sartura spins in a relentless whirlwind, inflicting heavy Physical damage to all nearby players while moving unpredictably.
ej/section/15516001/text.note: what an ability or phase of Battleguard Sartura, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj does (title: Whirlwind)

ej/section/15516002/text.en: Sartura cleaves all enemies before her, inflicting heavy Physical damage.
ej/section/15516002/text.note: what an ability or phase of Battleguard Sartura, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj does (title: Sundering Cleave)

ej/section/15516003/text.en: Sartura enrages, increasing her attack speed and the damage she deals.
ej/section/15516003/text.note: what an ability or phase of Battleguard Sartura, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj does (title: Enrage)

ej/section/15516004/title.note: the name of an ability or phase of Battleguard Sartura, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj

ej/section/15516004/text.en: Sartura fights alongside her Royal Guards, who also whirlwind and must be controlled by the raid.
ej/section/15516004/text.note: what an ability or phase of Battleguard Sartura, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj does (title: Royal Guards)

ej/section/15510001/text.en: Fankriss's strikes inflict Mortal Wounds, a stacking debuff that reduces the healing his target receives.
ej/section/15510001/text.note: what an ability or phase of Fankriss the Unyielding, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj does (title: Mortal Wound)

ej/section/15510002/text.en: Fankriss entangles a random player in webbing, rooting them in place and spawning a Spawn of Fankriss to attack them.
ej/section/15510002/text.note: what an ability or phase of Fankriss the Unyielding, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj does (title: Entangle)

ej/section/15510003/title.note: the name of an ability or phase of Fankriss the Unyielding, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj

ej/section/15510003/text.en: Fankriss teleports players into his brood and summons Spawns of Fankriss and Vekniss Hatchlings to overwhelm the raid.
ej/section/15510003/text.note: what an ability or phase of Fankriss the Unyielding, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj does (title: Summon Spawns)

ej/section/15299001/title.note: the name of an ability or phase of Viscidus, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj

ej/section/15299001/text.en: Viscidus is vulnerable to Frost. Enough Frost damage slows and then freezes him solid, after which a flurry of melee blows shatters him into Glob oozes.
ej/section/15299001/text.note: what an ability or phase of Viscidus, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj does (title: Frost Vulnerability)

ej/section/15299002/text.en: Viscidus hurls a volley of poison bolts, inflicting Nature damage to the raid.
ej/section/15299002/text.note: what an ability or phase of Viscidus, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj does (title: Poison Bolt Volley)

ej/section/15299003/text.en: Viscidus poisons his attackers with a virulent toxin, inflicting Nature damage over time.
ej/section/15299003/text.note: what an ability or phase of Viscidus, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj does (title: Toxin)

ej/section/15509001/text.en: Huhuran periodically enters a frenzy, increasing her attack and casting speed. It can be soothed by a hunter's Tranquilizing Shot.
ej/section/15509001/text.note: what an ability or phase of Princess Huhuran, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj does (title: Frenzy)

ej/section/15509002/text.en: Below 30% health, Huhuran goes berserk, unleashing relentless torrents of poison on the entire raid until she falls.
ej/section/15509002/text.note: what an ability or phase of Princess Huhuran, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj does (title: Berserk)

ej/section/15509003/text.en: Huhuran sprays a noxious poison, inflicting Nature damage over time to those it strikes.
ej/section/15509003/text.note: what an ability or phase of Princess Huhuran, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj does (title: Noxious Poison)

ej/section/15509004/text.en: Huhuran stings a player, sending them into a poisoned slumber until the venom runs its course.
ej/section/15509004/text.note: what an ability or phase of Princess Huhuran, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj does (title: Wyvern Sting)

ej/section/15276001/title.note: the name of an ability or phase of The Twin Emperors, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj

ej/section/15276001/text.en: The emperors swap positions every thirty seconds and heal one another to full whenever they stand close together — they must be tanked far apart and brought low at the same time.
ej/section/15276001/text.note: what an ability or phase of The Twin Emperors, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj does (title: Twin Teleport & Heal)

ej/section/15276002/title.note: the name of an ability or phase of The Twin Emperors, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj

ej/section/15276002/text.en: Emperor Vek'lor hurls heavy Shadow Bolts at the raid from range.
ej/section/15276002/text.note: what an ability or phase of The Twin Emperors, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj does (title: Vek'lor: Shadow Bolt)

ej/section/15276003/title.note: the name of an ability or phase of The Twin Emperors, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj

ej/section/15276003/text.en: When struck in melee, Emperor Vek'lor releases an Arcane Burst, inflicting heavy Arcane damage and knocking nearby players back — he must be fought at range.
ej/section/15276003/text.note: what an ability or phase of The Twin Emperors, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj does (title: Vek'lor: Arcane Burst)

ej/section/15276004/title.note: the name of an ability or phase of The Twin Emperors, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj

ej/section/15276004/text.en: Emperor Vek'lor conjures a blizzard, inflicting Frost damage over a wide area.
ej/section/15276004/text.note: what an ability or phase of The Twin Emperors, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj does (title: Vek'lor: Blizzard)

ej/section/15276005/title.note: the name of an ability or phase of The Twin Emperors, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj

ej/section/15276005/text.en: Emperor Vek'nilash delivers an unbalancing strike, inflicting heavy Physical damage and reducing his target's defense.
ej/section/15276005/text.note: what an ability or phase of The Twin Emperors, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj does (title: Vek'nilash: Unbalancing Strike)

ej/section/15276006/title.note: the name of an ability or phase of The Twin Emperors, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj

ej/section/15276006/text.en: Emperor Vek'nilash launches his target into the air with a mighty uppercut.
ej/section/15276006/text.note: what an ability or phase of The Twin Emperors, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj does (title: Vek'nilash: Uppercut)

ej/section/15517001/text.en: Ouro unleashes a sand blast, inflicting massive Nature damage to players in front of him.
ej/section/15517001/text.note: what an ability or phase of Ouro, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj does (title: Sand Blast)

ej/section/15517002/text.en: When Ouro erupts from the sand, the ground ruptures beneath the raid, inflicting Physical damage and knocking players back.
ej/section/15517002/text.note: what an ability or phase of Ouro, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj does (title: Ground Rupture)

ej/section/15517003/title.note: the name of an ability or phase of Ouro, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj

ej/section/15517003/text.en: Ouro periodically burrows beneath the sand, summoning Dirt Mounds and Ouro Scarabs before erupting back to the surface.
ej/section/15517003/text.note: what an ability or phase of Ouro, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj does (title: Submerge & Summon)

ej/section/15517004/title.note: the name of an ability or phase of Ouro, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj

ej/section/15517004/text.en: If the fight runs long, Ouro enrages, vastly increasing the damage he deals.
ej/section/15517004/text.note: what an ability or phase of Ouro, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj does (title: Enrage)

ej/section/15727001/text.en: In its eye phase, C'Thun's great eye unleashes a rotating Dark Glare — a sweeping beam that instantly kills anything it touches. Take cover behind the chamber's pillars.
ej/section/15727001/text.note: what an ability or phase of C'Thun, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj does (title: Dark Glare)

ej/section/15727002/text.en: C'Thun's eye fires green beams that chain between nearby players, inflicting Nature damage.
ej/section/15727002/text.note: what an ability or phase of C'Thun, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj does (title: Eye Beam)

ej/section/15727003/title.note: the name of an ability or phase of C'Thun, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj

ej/section/15727003/text.en: In its body phase, C'Thun swallows players whole into its stomach, where two Flesh Tentacles must be destroyed to leave C'Thun vulnerable. Giant Claw and Eye Tentacles erupt from the body throughout.
ej/section/15727003/text.note: what an ability or phase of C'Thun, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj does (title: Flesh Tentacles & Stomach)

ej/section/15727004/text.en: Players swallowed into C'Thun's stomach are bathed in digestive acid, taking steady Nature damage until they escape.
ej/section/15727004/text.note: what an ability or phase of C'Thun, a boss in Temple of Ahn'Qiraj does (title: Digestive Acid)

ej/instance/754/desc.en: Floating above the Plaguelands, the necropolis known as Naxxramas serves as the seat of one of the Lich King's most powerful officers, the dreaded lich Kel'Thuzad. Horrors of the past and new terrors yet to be unleashed are gathering inside the necropolis as the Lich King's servants prepare their assault. Soon the Scourge will march again...
ej/instance/754/desc.note: the Adventure Guide's description of Naxxramas

ej/section/15956001/text.en: Anub'Rekhan erupts a line of impaling spikes from the ground, inflicting heavy Physical damage and hurling players into the air.
ej/section/15956001/text.note: what an ability or phase of Anub'Rekhan, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Impale)

ej/section/15956002/text.en: Anub'Rekhan surrounds himself with a swarm of locusts, draining the life of nearby players and silencing them. The tank must kite him away until it ends.
ej/section/15956002/text.note: what an ability or phase of Anub'Rekhan, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Locust Swarm)

ej/section/15956003/title.note: the name of an ability or phase of Anub'Rekhan, a boss in Naxxramas

ej/section/15956003/text.en: Slain Crypt Guards and the boss's own corpse erupt with Corpse Scarabs that swarm the raid.
ej/section/15956003/text.note: what an ability or phase of Anub'Rekhan, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Corpse Scarabs)

ej/section/15953001/text.en: Faerlina looses a volley of poison bolts, inflicting heavy Nature damage to the raid.
ej/section/15953001/text.note: what an ability or phase of Grand Widow Faerlina, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Poison Bolt Volley)

ej/section/15953002/text.en: Faerlina calls down a rain of fire, inflicting Fire damage to all players in the area.
ej/section/15953002/text.note: what an ability or phase of Grand Widow Faerlina, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Rain of Fire)

ej/section/15953003/title.note: the name of an ability or phase of Grand Widow Faerlina, a boss in Naxxramas

ej/section/15953003/text.en: Faerlina enrages, vastly increasing her damage. Mind-controlling one of her Worshippers and unleashing its Widow's Embrace removes the frenzy and silences her.
ej/section/15953003/text.note: what an ability or phase of Grand Widow Faerlina, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Frenzy)

ej/section/15952001/text.en: Maexxna hurls players against the cavern walls, cocooning them in webbing until they are freed by their allies.
ej/section/15952001/text.note: what an ability or phase of Maexxna, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Web Wrap)

ej/section/15952002/text.en: Maexxna sprays the raid with webbing, stunning everyone for several seconds.
ej/section/15952002/text.note: what an ability or phase of Maexxna, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Web Spray)

ej/section/15952003/text.en: Maexxna's bite injects a necrotic poison, sharply reducing the healing her target receives.
ej/section/15952003/text.note: what an ability or phase of Maexxna, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Necrotic Poison)

ej/section/15952004/title.note: the name of an ability or phase of Maexxna, a boss in Naxxramas

ej/section/15952004/text.en: Below 30% health, Maexxna enters a frenzy, attacking with greatly increased speed.
ej/section/15952004/text.note: what an ability or phase of Maexxna, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Frenzy)

ej/section/15954001/text.en: Noth curses the raid; after a few seconds the curse erupts, inflicting heavy Shadow damage to anyone still afflicted.
ej/section/15954001/text.note: what an ability or phase of Noth the Plaguebringer, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Curse of the Plaguebringer)

ej/section/15954002/text.en: Noth cripples a player, slowing their attack and movement speed and weakening their strength.
ej/section/15954002/text.note: what an ability or phase of Noth the Plaguebringer, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Cripple)

ej/section/15954003/title.note: the name of an ability or phase of Noth the Plaguebringer, a boss in Naxxramas

ej/section/15954003/text.en: Noth blinks free of melee and raises Plagued Champions and Warriors, periodically teleporting to his balcony to send skeletons against the raid.
ej/section/15954003/text.note: what an ability or phase of Noth the Plaguebringer, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Blink & Raise Dead)

ej/section/15936001/text.en: Heigan channels eruptions of plague that sweep across the floor in sequence. Players must move through the safe zones in rhythm — the infamous Safety Dance — or be killed instantly.
ej/section/15936001/text.note: what an ability or phase of Heigan the Unclean, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Eruption)

ej/section/15936002/text.en: Heigan afflicts the raid with Decrepit Fever, a disease that inflicts Nature damage over time and reduces maximum health.
ej/section/15936002/text.note: what an ability or phase of Heigan the Unclean, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Decrepit Fever)

ej/section/15936003/title.note: the name of an ability or phase of Heigan the Unclean, a boss in Naxxramas

ej/section/15936003/text.en: Heigan disrupts the magic around him, sharply increasing the mana cost of the raid's spells.
ej/section/15936003/text.note: what an ability or phase of Heigan the Unclean, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Spell Disruption)

ej/section/16011001/title.note: the name of an ability or phase of Loatheb, a boss in Naxxramas

ej/section/16011001/text.en: Loatheb radiates a Necrotic Aura that prevents nearly all healing. Healing lands only in brief windows between its pulses, demanding precise cooldown timing.
ej/section/16011001/text.note: what an ability or phase of Loatheb, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Necrotic Aura)

ej/section/16011002/text.en: As the fight wears on, Loatheb inflicts Inevitable Doom at ever-shorter intervals, dealing escalating Shadow damage the healers must survive between Necrotic Aura windows.
ej/section/16011002/text.note: what an ability or phase of Loatheb, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Inevitable Doom)

ej/section/16011003/title.note: the name of an ability or phase of Loatheb, a boss in Naxxramas

ej/section/16011003/text.en: Loatheb periodically releases Spores; players spread out to soak them and gain the Fungal Bloom buff needed to maximize their damage.
ej/section/16011003/text.note: what an ability or phase of Loatheb, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Spores)

ej/section/16061001/title.note: the name of an ability or phase of Instructor Razuvious, a boss in Naxxramas

ej/section/16061001/text.en: Razuvious can only be held by his Death Knight Understudies, which the raid must mind-control with Obedience Crystals and use to tank him.
ej/section/16061001/text.note: what an ability or phase of Instructor Razuvious, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Understudies)

ej/section/16061002/text.en: Razuvious delivers an unbalancing strike, inflicting heavy Physical damage and reducing his target's defense.
ej/section/16061002/text.note: what an ability or phase of Instructor Razuvious, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Unbalancing Strike)

ej/section/16061003/text.en: Razuvious lets out a disrupting shout, inflicting heavy damage to everyone near him.
ej/section/16061003/text.note: what an ability or phase of Instructor Razuvious, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Disrupting Shout)

ej/section/16060001/title.note: the name of an ability or phase of Gothik the Harvester, a boss in Naxxramas

ej/section/16060001/text.en: Gothik divides the raid across a gate into living and dead sides, sending waves of undead that cross over when slain. He cannot be reached until every add falls.
ej/section/16060001/text.note: what an ability or phase of Gothik the Harvester, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Split Realm)

ej/section/16060002/text.en: Once he descends to fight, Gothik hurls Shadow Bolts at the raid, inflicting heavy Shadow damage.
ej/section/16060002/text.note: what an ability or phase of Gothik the Harvester, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Shadow Bolt)

ej/section/16060003/text.en: Gothik harvests the souls of nearby players, inflicting Shadow damage.
ej/section/16060003/text.note: what an ability or phase of Gothik the Harvester, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Harvest Soul)

ej/section/16065001/title.note: the name of an ability or phase of The Four Horsemen, a boss in Naxxramas

ej/section/16065001/text.en: Each Horseman brands their target with a Mark that stacks ever higher and more painful. Tanks and raid must rotate around the four corners of the room to keep their stacks from turning lethal.
ej/section/16065001/text.note: what an ability or phase of The Four Horsemen, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Mark of the Horsemen)

ej/section/16065002/title.note: the name of an ability or phase of The Four Horsemen, a boss in Naxxramas

ej/section/16065002/text.en: Thane Korth'azz hurls fiery Meteors that inflict massive Fire damage split among nearby players.
ej/section/16065002/text.note: what an ability or phase of The Four Horsemen, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Meteor)

ej/section/16065003/title.note: the name of an ability or phase of The Four Horsemen, a boss in Naxxramas

ej/section/16065003/text.en: Lady Blaumeux conjures Void Zones of shadow on the ground that inflict heavy damage to any who stand in them.
ej/section/16065003/text.note: what an ability or phase of The Four Horsemen, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Void Zone)

ej/section/16065004/text.en: Sir Zeliek, fighting against his will, looses Holy Wrath and chains of holy lightning across the raid.
ej/section/16065004/text.note: what an ability or phase of The Four Horsemen, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Holy Wrath)

ej/section/16065005/title.note: the name of an ability or phase of The Four Horsemen, a boss in Naxxramas

ej/section/16065005/text.en: Baron Rivendare blankets areas of the floor in Death and Decay, inflicting Shadow damage over time to any who remain.
ej/section/16065005/text.note: what an ability or phase of The Four Horsemen, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Death and Decay)

ej/section/16028001/text.en: Patchwerk pounds the highest-health player within melee range with a Hateful Strike for enormous Physical damage. Off-tanks must stack in close to absorb these blows.
ej/section/16028001/text.note: what an ability or phase of Patchwerk, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Hateful Strike)

ej/section/16028002/text.en: Below 5% health, Patchwerk enrages, dramatically increasing his attack speed for a frantic final push.
ej/section/16028002/text.note: what an ability or phase of Patchwerk, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Enrage)

ej/section/15931001/text.en: Grobbulus injects a player with a mutating agent. When it expires or is dispelled it bursts into a lingering Poison Cloud, so the afflicted must carry it to the edge of the room.
ej/section/15931001/text.note: what an ability or phase of Grobbulus, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Mutating Injection)

ej/section/15931002/title.note: the name of an ability or phase of Grobbulus, a boss in Naxxramas

ej/section/15931002/text.en: Grobbulus trails clouds of poison gas as he moves, which expand and inflict escalating Nature damage — the raid must keep the floor clear.
ej/section/15931002/text.note: what an ability or phase of Grobbulus, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Poison Cloud)

ej/section/15931003/text.en: Grobbulus sprays a cone of slime, inflicting Nature damage and spawning a Fallout Slime.
ej/section/15931003/text.note: what an ability or phase of Grobbulus, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Slime Spray)

ej/section/15932001/text.en: Gluth decimates the raid and his Zombie Chow, dropping everyone to a sliver of health. The zombies must be cut down before they reach and heal him.
ej/section/15932001/text.note: what an ability or phase of Gluth, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Decimate)

ej/section/15932002/text.en: Gluth's bite inflicts Mortal Wounds, a stacking debuff that reduces the healing his tank receives.
ej/section/15932002/text.note: what an ability or phase of Gluth, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Mortal Wound)

ej/section/15932003/text.en: Gluth lets out a terrifying roar, causing nearby players to flee in fear.
ej/section/15932003/text.note: what an ability or phase of Gluth, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Terrifying Roar)

ej/section/15932004/title.note: the name of an ability or phase of Gluth, a boss in Naxxramas

ej/section/15932004/text.en: A steady stream of Zombie Chow shambles toward Gluth; any that reach him heal him substantially.
ej/section/15932004/text.note: what an ability or phase of Gluth, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Zombie Chow)

ej/section/15928001/text.en: Thaddius assigns every player a positive or negative charge. Like charges amplify one another; opposite charges are lethal on contact — the raid must split by polarity instantly.
ej/section/15928001/text.note: what an ability or phase of Thaddius, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Polarity Shift)

ej/section/15928002/text.en: Thaddius unleashes chain lightning that arcs across the raid, inflicting Nature damage to all it strikes.
ej/section/15928002/text.note: what an ability or phase of Thaddius, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Chain Lightning)

ej/section/15928003/title.note: the name of an ability or phase of Thaddius, a boss in Naxxramas

ej/section/15928003/text.en: Thaddius is guarded by the constructs Stalagg and Feugen, who must be slain within seconds of each other; their Power Surge and Static Field punish the raid until both fall.
ej/section/15928003/text.note: what an ability or phase of Thaddius, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Stalagg & Feugen)

ej/section/15989001/text.en: Sapphiron radiates a Frost Aura, inflicting constant Frost damage to the entire raid — frost resistance is essential.
ej/section/15989001/text.note: what an ability or phase of Sapphiron, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Frost Aura)

ej/section/15989002/title.note: the name of an ability or phase of Sapphiron, a boss in Naxxramas

ej/section/15989002/text.en: From the air, Sapphiron exhales a catastrophic Frost Breath across the chamber. Only players sheltered behind a block of ice survive it.
ej/section/15989002/text.note: what an ability or phase of Sapphiron, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Frost Breath)

ej/section/15989003/text.en: During his flight phase, Sapphiron entombs players in blocks of ice, which then serve as cover against his Frost Breath.
ej/section/15989003/text.note: what an ability or phase of Sapphiron, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Icebolt)

ej/section/15989004/text.en: Sapphiron drains the life of several players at once, healing himself for the damage dealt.
ej/section/15989004/text.note: what an ability or phase of Sapphiron, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Life Drain)

ej/section/15989005/title.note: the name of an ability or phase of Sapphiron, a boss in Naxxramas

ej/section/15989005/text.en: Sapphiron conjures roaming blizzards that inflict heavy Frost damage to any caught within them.
ej/section/15989005/text.note: what an ability or phase of Sapphiron, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Blizzard)

ej/section/15990001/text.en: Kel'Thuzad hurls a massive Frostbolt at the raid, inflicting heavy Frost damage.
ej/section/15990001/text.note: what an ability or phase of Kel'Thuzad, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Frostbolt)

ej/section/15990002/text.en: Kel'Thuzad encases a player in frost, freezing them solid and spreading lethal cold to anyone standing near them.
ej/section/15990002/text.note: what an ability or phase of Kel'Thuzad, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Frost Blast)

ej/section/15990003/text.en: Kel'Thuzad enslaves several players with shadowy chains, turning them against the raid until the chains are broken.
ej/section/15990003/text.note: what an ability or phase of Kel'Thuzad, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Chains of Kel'Thuzad)

ej/section/15990004/text.en: Kel'Thuzad opens shadow fissures beneath the raid; any player still standing over one when it erupts is slain.
ej/section/15990004/text.note: what an ability or phase of Kel'Thuzad, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Shadow Fissure)

ej/section/15990005/title.note: the name of an ability or phase of Kel'Thuzad, a boss in Naxxramas

ej/section/15990005/text.en: Kel'Thuzad looses a volley of frostbolts, inflicting Frost damage to all nearby players.
ej/section/15990005/text.note: what an ability or phase of Kel'Thuzad, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Frostbolt Volley)

ej/section/15990006/text.en: Kel'Thuzad detonates the mana of the raid's casters, inflicting Arcane damage based on the amount destroyed.
ej/section/15990006/text.note: what an ability or phase of Kel'Thuzad, a boss in Naxxramas does (title: Mana Detonation)

ej/section/29112/text.en: Rhahk'Zor savagely mauls his current target, inflicting 64 to 86 Physical damage and stunning them for 3 sec.

ej/section/4701/text.en: Walking Bomb detonates when it reaches its target, inflicting 200 to 300 Fire damage to all players within 10 yards.

ej/section/29862/text.en: Theka hurls missiles of dark magic, inflicting 128 to 172 Shadow damage to nearby enemies.

ej/section/4986/text.en: Antu'sul heals an ally for 694 to 806.

ej/section/4990/text.en: Antu'sul strikes an enemy with a lightning bolt that arcs to other nearby players, inflicting 185 to 215 Nature damage and jumping to up to 3 nearby enemies.

ej/section/5015/text.en: Witch Doctor Zum'rah heals an ally for 694 to 806.

ej/section/5016/text.en: Witch Doctor Zum'rah hurls a bolt of dark magic at a player, inflicting 128 to 172 Shadow damage.

ej/section/5017/text.en: Witch Doctor Zum'rah hurls missiles of dark magic, inflicting 128 to 172 Shadow damage to all players within 30 yards.

ej/section/5021/text.en: Shadow Priest Sezz'ziz hurls a bolt of dark magic at a player, inflicting 128 to 172 Shadow damage.

ej/section/5024/text.en: Shadow Priest Sezz'ziz heals an ally for 590 to 684.

ej/section/4919/text.en: Tendris Warpwood inflicts 525 to 675 Physical damage to all players within 10 yards, knocking them down and immobilizing them for 10 sec.

ej/section/4754/text.en: Prince Tortheldrin inflicts 875 to 1125 Arcane damage to a player and knocks them back.

ej/section/4994/text.en: Lethtendris inflicts 925 to 1075 Shadow damage to her target.

ej/section/4995/text.en: Lethtendris inflicts 128 to 172 Shadow damage to all players within 30 yards.

ej/section/5001/text.en: Pimgib inflicts 122 to 140 Fire damage to all players within 10 yards and reduces their movement speed by 50% for 6 sec.

ej/section/5008/text.en: Hydrospawn summons a Massive Geyser that inflicts 463 to 537 Frost damage to all players within 10 yards and knocks them back.

ej/section/29563/text.en: Zevrim Thornhoof hurls missiles of dark magic, inflicting 128 to 172 Shadow damage to nearby enemies within 30 yards.

ej/section/6463/text.en: Vengeful Phantom shocks player with ice, inflicting 89 to 95 Frost damage and reducing their movement speed by 50% for 8 sec.

ej/section/4800/text.en: Timmy the Cruel lashes out, inflicting 925 to 1075 Physical damage to all enemies in front of him and healing himself for 100% of damage dealt.

ej/section/6452/text.en: Commander Malor smashes the ground, inflicting 96 to 128 Physical damage to all players within 10 yards and stunning them for 3 sec.

ej/section/6454/text.en: Commander Malor hurls missiles of dark magic, inflicting 128 to 172 Shadow damage to all players within 30 yards.

ej/section/4808/text.en: Instructor Galford unleashes a fire nova, inflicting 197 to 227 Fire damage to all enemies within 10 yards.

ej/section/4842/text.en: Baroness Anastari wails with anguish, inflicting 128 to 172 Shadow damage to her current target.

ej/section/4854/text.en: Maleki the Pallid inflicts 48 to 64 Frost damage to his current target, reducing their movement speed by 50% for 4 sec.

ej/section/29936/text.en: Lord Aurius Rivendare hurls a bolt of dark magic at a player, inflicting 128 to 172 Shadow damage.

ej/section/4866/text.en: Lord Aurius Rivendare hurls a large bolt of dark magic at a player, inflicting 288 to 388 Shadow damage.
